title: Fury HQ — 2026
text: The year is 2026. On Planet Earth, the United States Government and Air Force formed a secret underground division of elite pilots from around the globe.

title: After the Cold War
text: After the Cold War, military tensions still remained high and caused world governments to form secret societies and organizations, including the Fury Division.

title: Why Fury exists
text: The Fury Division was created for the sole purpose of defending us against unforeseen attacks and anomalies unknown to us all.

title: The remaining nine
text: The Division has had many pilots come and go. But as the former generations grew old and rivalries formed, the remaining nine pilots were left seeking answers.

title: Machines turn on man
text: Something unknown had reached our world.

title: Alarms at dispatch
text: Are you seeing this? Signals are going off everywhere!

title: Tell the others
text: Oh my God! We have got to tell the others, now!

title: Infrastructure hijacked
text: Our infrastructure was hijacked. Machines turned on man.

title: Homes under attack
text: They are firing on homes! Get everyone away from the road!

title: City under attack
text: Aircraft are attacking the city. We cannot regain control!

title: No answer
text: What the..? Hello? Team Fury, come in. I repeat, Team Fury, come in!

title: Return to base
text: Weird, radar is down too. I gotta get back to the base and find the others. Something is wrong.

title: Something in the jungle
text: But what is going on down there in that jungle? Is it one of them?

title: Logo, boost and fade
text: The Bullets of Fury logo flashes in with rumble. The selected pilot’s active thrusters flare; the actual aircraft accelerates off screen without firing. Picture and music fade into the campaign map.
